title: ReadyStatus Weather Decision Matrix
description: Maps weather hazards to a recommended facility operating posture. These are prototype mappings, and a manager approves the final status.
note: Prototype mappings. Numeric cutoffs are NWS criteria where noted, otherwise configurable review thresholds. A human approves the final status. Missing or stale data is never treated as safe.

levels.title: Advisory
levels.description: Conditions are worth watching but do not change the schedule.

levels.title: Action
levels.description: Conditions affect travel or the workday. Adjust the schedule or work location.

levels.title: Critical
levels.description: Conditions threaten safety or access. Close the facility or shelter in place.

rules.title: Light snow
rules.description: A winter weather advisory is in effect or 1 to 2.9 inches of snow is expected. Operate normally and keep watching conditions.
rules.trigger: NWS Winter Weather Advisory, or snow 1-2.9 in
rules.basis: NWS CAP severity; agency occupant emergency plan

rules.title: Cold wind chill
rules.description: Wind chill is between -9 and -1 °F. Dress for the cold and check that building heat is working.
rules.trigger: Wind chill -1 to -9 F
rules.basis: NWS cold-weather criteria

rules.title: Windy conditions
rules.description: Sustained winds of 31 to 39 mph or gusts of 46 to 57 mph. Expect difficult driving for high-profile vehicles and loose outdoor objects.
rules.trigger: NWS Wind Advisory, or sustained wind 31-39 mph, or gusts 46-57 mph
rules.basis: NWS Wind Advisory criteria

rules.title: Hot and humid
rules.description: Heat index of 105 to 109 °F. Encourage hydration and limit time outdoors.
rules.trigger: NWS Heat Advisory, or heat index 105-109 F
rules.basis: NWS Heat Advisory criteria (NWS Kansas City)

rules.title: Dense fog
rules.description: Visibility is a quarter mile or less. Allow extra commute time and drive with low beams.
rules.trigger: NWS Dense Fog Advisory, or visibility <= 0.25 mi
rules.basis: NWS Dense Fog Advisory criteria

rules.title: Flood watch or heavy rain
rules.description: A flood watch or advisory is active, or rain is falling at 1 inch per hour or more. Watch for ponding on commute routes.
rules.trigger: NWS Flood Watch or Flood Advisory, or rain >= 1 in/hr
rules.basis: NWS flood alert taxonomy; rain rate is a prototype review threshold

rules.title: Lightning nearby
rules.description: Lightning within 10 miles. Stay indoors and suspend outdoor work until 30 minutes after the last thunder.
rules.trigger: Lightning within 10 mi; suspend outdoor activity until 30 min after last thunder
rules.basis: NWS lightning safety guidance

rules.title: Morning snow or ice, improving
rules.description: Ice has begun to accumulate or 3 to 5.9 inches of snow ends before 7 AM, and roads should improve by 10 AM. Delay arrival by two hours to allow plowing and treatment.
rules.trigger: Ice >= 0.05 in, or snow 3-5.9 in ending before 7 AM, with roads improving by 10 AM
rules.basis: MoDOT road-condition categories; OPM delayed-arrival status

rules.title: Morning dense fog
rules.description: Visibility is a quarter mile or less at the start of the commute and is expected to lift by 10 AM. Delay arrival by two hours.
rules.trigger: Visibility <= 0.25 mi at start of commute and forecast to lift by 10 AM
rules.basis: NWS Dense Fog Advisory; OPM delayed-arrival status

rules.title: Morning wind gusts
rules.description: Gusts of 40 mph or more during the morning commute that should subside by 10 AM. Delay arrival by two hours.
rules.trigger: Gusts >= 40 mph during morning commute, forecast to subside by 10 AM
rules.basis: Prototype review threshold; confirm against local NWS criteria

rules.title: Morning flooding, receding
rules.description: A flood advisory or watch overlaps the commute, or 1 to 5.9 inches of water stands on a key route and should recede by 10 AM. Delay arrival by two hours.
rules.trigger: NWS Flood Advisory/Watch overlapping the morning commute, or standing water on a critical route expected to recede by 10 AM
rules.basis: NWS flood safety; MoDOT traveler map

rules.title: Snow or ice arriving during the workday
rules.description: A warning-level event starts before 5 PM, with at least 2 inches of snow or any ice. Release employees early so they can travel before conditions worsen.
rules.trigger: Warning-level hazard starting during office hours: snow >= 2 in or any ice before 5 PM
rules.basis: NWS warning onset time; evening commute window

rules.title: Severe storms before the evening commute
rules.description: A severe thunderstorm watch or warning is expected to reach the area during the evening commute, with hail of 1 inch or more or gusts of 58 mph or more. Release employees early only if departure is still safe.
rules.trigger: Severe Thunderstorm Watch/Warning forecast to reach the area during the evening commute (hail >= 1 in or gusts >= 58 mph)
rules.basis: NWS severe thunderstorm criteria; departure must still be safe

rules.title: Heat with weak cooling
rules.description: Heat index is 105 °F or higher and indoor cooling is not keeping up. Release employees early to avoid heat illness.
rules.trigger: Heat index >= 105 F with indoor cooling degraded
rules.basis: NWS Heat Advisory criteria; facility HVAC status

rules.title: Dangerous wind chill
rules.description: Wind chill is -20 °F or colder during the morning commute, but roads are passable. Eligible employees may work remotely.
rules.trigger: Wind chill <= -20 F during the morning commute while roads stay passable
rules.basis: NWS cold-weather warning criteria; OPM unscheduled leave and telework option

rules.title: Excessive heat
rules.description: An excessive heat warning is in effect or the heat index is 110 °F or higher. Eligible employees may work remotely.
rules.trigger: NWS Excessive Heat Warning, or heat index >= 110 F
rules.basis: NWS Excessive Heat Warning criteria (NWS Kansas City)

rules.title: Flooded access route
rules.description: A critical access route is closed or has 6 inches or more of water, and no safe alternate exists. The building is safe, so eligible employees may work remotely.
rules.trigger: Critical access route closed or flooded (water >= 6 in) with no verified alternate, facility itself safe
rules.basis: NWS 'Turn Around, Don't Drown' (6 in can stall or sweep a vehicle); MoDOT closures

rules.title: High wind warning
rules.description: A high wind warning is in effect, with sustained winds of 40 mph or more or gusts of 58 mph or more. Travel is hazardous, so eligible employees may work remotely.
rules.trigger: NWS High Wind Warning, or sustained >= 40 mph, or gusts >= 58 mph
rules.basis: NWS High Wind Warning criteria

rules.title: Major winter storm
rules.description: A winter storm, ice storm or blizzard warning covers the workday, snow is 6 inches or more, ice is a quarter inch or more, or roads are snow covered. The office is closed.
rules.trigger: NWS Winter Storm, Ice Storm, or Blizzard Warning through the workday, snow >= 6 in, ice >= 0.25 in, or roads covered
rules.basis: NWS warning taxonomy; OPM closure status; agency continuity plan

rules.title: Life-threatening cold
rules.description: Wind chill is -35 °F or colder, or the heat has failed and the building is below 60 °F. The office is closed.
rules.trigger: Wind chill <= -35 F, or heating failure with unsafe indoor temperature (< 60 F)
rules.basis: NWS Extreme Cold Warning escalation; facility safety

rules.title: Tornado warning at the facility
rules.description: A tornado warning covers the facility. Move everyone to shelter now. Do not send people onto the road.
rules.trigger: Tornado Warning polygon intersects the facility
rules.basis: NWS Tornado Warning; facility emergency plan. Do not send occupants onto roads.

rules.title: Flash flood threat
rules.description: A flash flood warning covers the facility or its access, water on the access route is 12 inches or deeper, or an evacuation order is in place. The office is closed.
rules.trigger: Flash Flood Warning covering the facility or critical access, water >= 12 in on access route, or official evacuation order
rules.basis: NWS flash flood warning; 12 in floats most cars

rules.title: Storm damage
rules.description: A severe thunderstorm warning is active and the facility is damaged, power lines are down, or a key route is blocked. Shelter in place and close the office.
rules.trigger: Severe Thunderstorm Warning with confirmed facility damage, downed power lines, or blocked critical route
rules.basis: NWS severe thunderstorm warning; verified facility condition

rules.title: Dangerous heat
rules.description: The building has reached 85 °F or higher after cooling failed, or the heat index is 115 °F or higher. The office is closed.
rules.trigger: Indoor temperature >= 85 F after HVAC failure, or Extreme Heat Warning with heat index >= 115 F
rules.basis: NWS Extreme Heat criteria; facility safety

rules.title: Facility unsafe
rules.description: The building is not safe to occupy, or power, water or heat has failed in a way that makes it unsafe. The office is closed.
rules.trigger: Facility not safe to occupy, or critical systems (power, water, heat) failed and unsafe
rules.basis: Verified facility condition; agency continuity plan

rules: Expired or cancelled alerts are not active.
An alert must intersect the facility or a relevant commute area to apply.
Unknown road conditions are not clear roads.
If critical data is missing or stale, return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and request manager review.
